  source_name,
  rule_name,
  passed_rows,
  failed_rows,
  run_ts)
DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_BINARY

CREATE VIEW ops.v_dq_rule_metrics (
  source_name,
  rule_name,
  passed_rows,
  failed_rows,
  failure_rate_pct,
  last_evaluated_ts,
  rule_status)
DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_BINARY
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS SELECT source_name, rule_name, sum(passed_rows) AS passed_rows, sum(failed_rows) AS failed_rows,
  round(100.0*sum(failed_rows)/greatest(sum(passed_rows)+sum(failed_rows),1), 2) AS failure_rate_pct,
  max(run_ts) AS last_evaluated_ts,
  CASE WHEN sum(failed_rows) > 0 THEN 'failing' ELSE 'passing' END AS rule_status
FROM mdd_platform.audit.dq_metrics GROUP BY 1,2
views.v_file_lifecycle_cost:
CREATE VIEW ops.v_file_lifecycle_cost (
  source_name,
  file_name,
  batch_id,
  run_id,
  run_ts,
  arrival_ts,
  bronze_ingest_ts,
  dq_ts,
  silver_merge_ts,
  arrival_to_bronze_seconds,
  bronze_run_seconds,
  dq_seconds,
  silver_merge_seconds,
  silver_run_seconds,
  total_lifecycle_seconds,
  raw_rows,
  bronze_rows,
  quarantined_rows,
  rescued_rows,
  silver_merged_rows,
  raw_file_bytes,
  bronze_bytes_pro_rata,
  silver_bytes_pro_rata,
  quarantine_bytes_pro_rata,
  total_storage_bytes,
  active_compute_seconds,
  price_per_dbu,
  dbus_allocated,
  cost_usd,
  cost_source,
  cost_per_row,
  cost_per_file,
  seconds_per_row)
COMMENT 'Per-file, per-microbatch lifecycle costing. CONFIG-DRIVEN: source/layer UNION blocks are generated from mdd_platform.config.pipeline_configs (active sources) - re-run the builder notebook to include new sources. DERIVATION (per-stage compute is not instrumented): stage durations are wall-clock spans between observed lifecycle events. arrival_to_bronze_seconds = bronze _ingest_ts - file mtime (exact). File-to-bronze attribution is exact via bronze._source_file. dq_seconds = quarantine write ts - bronze ingest ts (upper bound of DQ evaluation; when a file produced no quarantined rows the ingest-to-merge window is split 50/50 between DQ and silver merge - documented assumption). silver_merge_seconds = first silver _merged_ts - quarantine write ts. total_lifecycle_seconds = first _merged_ts - file mtime (end-to-end). Compute time for costing uses audit.run_log bronze/silver-layer run durations allocated pro-rata by raw row share within each run (bronze_run_seconds, silver_run_seconds). COST PRO-RATION: DBU cost is taken from system.billing.usage for orchestration job 736782493336258 when telemetry has landed (about 1 day lag) and allocated to files pro-rata by raw rows; until then it is ESTIMATED as active_compute_seconds / 3600 x 1.0 DBU per active compute-hour (assumed single-worker serverless jobs execution) x the serverless jobs DBU list price from system.billing.list_prices (cost_source marks the basis). STORAGE: raw_file_bytes exact from the landing volume; bronze/silver/quarantine bytes are pro-rata shares (by rows) of the per-layer table sizes from mdd_platform.ops.v_storage_footprint (silver layer includes SCD2 _history bytes; that view sources system.storage.table_metrics_history latest daily snapshots - run its builder BEFORE this one). Silver row attribution is pro-rata by raw rows when multiple files share one microbatch (documented).'
DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_BINARY
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS WITH
landing AS (
  SELECT regexp_extract(_metadata.file_path, 'source_files/([^/]+)/', 1) AS source_name,
         _metadata.file_name AS file_name,
         cast(max(_metadata.file_modification_time) AS timestamp) AS file_mtime,
         max(_metadata.file_size) AS raw_file_bytes
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/mdd_platform/landing/source_files/', format => 'csv')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
bronze_files AS (
  SELECT 'src_001_customers' AS source_name, regexp_extract(_source_file, '([^/]+)$', 1) AS file_name,
         cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, max(_ingest_ts) AS _ingest_ts,
         max(_file_mtime) AS _file_mtime, count(*) AS raw_rows, count(_rescued_data) AS rescued_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_001_customers GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_002_orders' AS source_name, regexp_extract(_source_file, '([^/]+)$', 1) AS file_name,
         cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, max(_ingest_ts) AS _ingest_ts,
         max(_file_mtime) AS _file_mtime, count(*) AS raw_rows, count(_rescued_data) AS rescued_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_002_orders GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_003_payments' AS source_name, regexp_extract(_source_file, '([^/]+)$', 1) AS file_name,
         cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, max(_ingest_ts) AS _ingest_ts,
         max(_file_mtime) AS _file_mtime, count(*) AS raw_rows, count(_rescued_data) AS rescued_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_003_payments GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_004_employees' AS source_name, regexp_extract(_source_file, '([^/]+)$', 1) AS file_name,
         cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, max(_ingest_ts) AS _ingest_ts,
         max(_file_mtime) AS _file_mtime, count(*) AS raw_rows, count(_rescued_data) AS rescued_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_004_employees GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_005_products' AS source_name, regexp_extract(_source_file, '([^/]+)$', 1) AS file_name,
         cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, max(_ingest_ts) AS _ingest_ts,
         max(_file_mtime) AS _file_mtime, count(*) AS raw_rows, count(_rescued_data) AS rescued_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_005_products GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_006_order_lines' AS source_name, regexp_extract(_source_file, '([^/]+)$', 1) AS file_name,
         cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, max(_ingest_ts) AS _ingest_ts,
         max(_file_mtime) AS _file_mtime, count(*) AS raw_rows, count(_rescued_data) AS rescued_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_006_order_lines GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_008_machine_vibration' AS source_name, regexp_extract(_source_file, '([^/]+)$', 1) AS file_name,
         cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, max(_ingest_ts) AS _ingest_ts,
         max(_file_mtime) AS _file_mtime, count(*) AS raw_rows, count(_rescued_data) AS rescued_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_008_machine_vibration GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
quarantine_batches AS (
  SELECT 'src_001_customers' AS source_name, cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, _ingest_ts,
         min(_quarantine_ts) AS dq_ts, count(*) AS quarantined_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.quarantine.src_001_customers GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_002_orders' AS source_name, cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, _ingest_ts,
         min(_quarantine_ts) AS dq_ts, count(*) AS quarantined_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.quarantine.src_002_orders GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_003_payments' AS source_name, cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, _ingest_ts,
         min(_quarantine_ts) AS dq_ts, count(*) AS quarantined_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.quarantine.src_003_payments GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_004_employees' AS source_name, cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, _ingest_ts,
         min(_quarantine_ts) AS dq_ts, count(*) AS quarantined_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.quarantine.src_004_employees GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_005_products' AS source_name, cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, _ingest_ts,
         min(_quarantine_ts) AS dq_ts, count(*) AS quarantined_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.quarantine.src_005_products GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_006_order_lines' AS source_name, cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, _ingest_ts,
         min(_quarantine_ts) AS dq_ts, count(*) AS quarantined_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.quarantine.src_006_order_lines GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_008_machine_vibration' AS source_name, cast(_batch_id AS bigint) AS batch_id, _ingest_ts,
         min(_quarantine_ts) AS dq_ts, count(*) AS quarantined_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.quarantine.src_008_machine_vibration GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
silver_batches AS (
  SELECT 'src_001_customers' AS source_name, _ingest_ts, count(*) AS silver_rows, min(_merged_ts) AS first_merge_ts
  FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_001_customers GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_002_orders' AS source_name, _ingest_ts, count(*) AS silver_rows, min(_merged_ts) AS first_merge_ts
  FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_002_orders GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_003_payments' AS source_name, _ingest_ts, count(*) AS silver_rows, min(_merged_ts) AS first_merge_ts
  FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_003_payments GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_004_employees' AS source_name, _ingest_ts, count(*) AS silver_rows, min(_merged_ts) AS first_merge_ts
  FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_004_employees GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_005_products' AS source_name, _ingest_ts, count(*) AS silver_rows, min(_merged_ts) AS first_merge_ts
  FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_005_products GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_006_order_lines' AS source_name, _ingest_ts, count(*) AS silver_rows, min(_merged_ts) AS first_merge_ts
  FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_006_order_lines GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'src_008_machine_vibration' AS source_name, _ingest_ts, count(*) AS silver_rows, min(_merged_ts) AS first_merge_ts
  FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_008_machine_vibration GROUP BY 1, 2
),
bronze_runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, source_name, start_ts, end_ts, coalesce(rows_read, 0) AS run_rows,
         greatest(unix_timestamp(end_ts) - unix_timestamp(start_ts), 0) AS run_seconds
  FROM mdd_platform.audit.run_log WHERE layer = 'bronze'
),
silver_runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, source_name, start_ts, coalesce(rows_merged, 0) AS run_rows,
         greatest(unix_timestamp(end_ts) - unix_timestamp(start_ts), 0) AS run_seconds
  FROM mdd_platform.audit.run_log WHERE layer = 'silver'
),
files AS (
  SELECT b.source_name, l.file_name, b.batch_id, b._ingest_ts AS bronze_ingest_ts,
         l.file_mtime AS arrival_ts, l.raw_file_bytes,
         b.raw_rows, b.raw_rows AS bronze_rows, b.rescued_rows
  FROM bronze_files b
  JOIN landing l ON l.source_name = b.source_name AND l.file_name = b.file_name
),
batch_totals AS (
  SELECT source_name, bronze_ingest_ts, sum(raw_rows) AS batch_raw_rows
  FROM files GROUP BY 1, 2
),
storage_footprint AS (
  -- Sourced from ops.v_storage_footprint (build that view first - see its builder notebook).
  -- silver_history (SCD2) bytes roll into 'silver'; row_count counts the primary silver table only.
  SELECT source_name,
         CASE layer WHEN 'silver_history' THEN 'silver' ELSE layer END AS layer,
         sum(bytes_on_disk) AS bytes_on_disk,
         sum(CASE WHEN layer <> 'silver_history' THEN row_count ELSE 0 END) AS row_count
  FROM mdd_platform.ops.v_storage_footprint
  WHERE layer IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'silver_history', 'quarantine')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
f2 AS (
  SELECT fs.*, bt.batch_raw_rows, qb.dq_ts,
         round(coalesce(qb.quarantined_rows, 0) * fs.raw_rows / greatest(bt.batch_raw_rows, 1), 2) AS quarantined_rows,
         sb.silver_rows AS silver_batch_rows, sb.first_merge_ts,
         jr.run_id AS bronze_run_id, jr.start_ts AS bronze_run_ts,
         coalesce(jr.run_seconds, 0) AS bronze_run_seconds_total, coalesce(jr.run_rows, 0) AS bronze_run_rows
  FROM files fs
  JOIN batch_totals bt ON bt.source_name = fs.source_name AND bt.bronze_ingest_ts = fs.bronze_ingest_ts
  LEFT JOIN quarantine_batches qb ON qb.source_name = fs.source_name AND qb._ingest_ts = fs.bronze_ingest_ts
  LEFT JOIN silver_batches sb ON sb.source_name = fs.source_name AND sb._ingest_ts = fs.bronze_ingest_ts
  LEFT JOIN bronze_runs jr ON jr.source_name = fs.source_name AND fs.bronze_ingest_ts BETWEEN jr.start_ts AND jr.end_ts
),
f3 AS (
  SELECT f2.*, sr.run_seconds AS silver_run_seconds_total, sr.run_rows AS silver_run_rows,
         row_number() OVER (
           PARTITION BY f2.source_name, f2.file_name
           ORDER BY abs(unix_timestamp(sr.start_ts) - coalesce(unix_timestamp(f2.first_merge_ts), unix_timestamp(f2.bronze_ingest_ts)))
         ) AS rn
  FROM f2 LEFT JOIN silver_runs sr ON sr.source_name = f2.source_name
),
f4 AS (
  SELECT f3.*,
         greatest(unix_timestamp(f3.bronze_ingest_ts) - unix_timestamp(f3.arrival_ts), 0) AS arrival_to_bronze_seconds,
         round(coalesce(f3.bronze_run_seconds_total, 0) * f3.raw_rows / greatest(f3.bronze_run_rows, 1), 3) AS bronze_run_seconds,
         CASE WHEN f3.dq_ts IS NOT NULL THEN greatest(unix_timestamp(f3.dq_ts) - unix_timestamp(f3.bronze_ingest_ts), 0)
              ELSE greatest(unix_timestamp(f3.first_merge_ts) - unix_timestamp(f3.bronze_ingest_ts), 0) * 0.5 END AS dq_seconds,
         CASE WHEN f3.dq_ts IS NOT NULL THEN greatest(unix_timestamp(f3.first_merge_ts) - unix_timestamp(f3.dq_ts), 0)
              ELSE greatest(unix_timestamp(f3.first_merge_ts) - unix_timestamp(f3.bronze_ingest_ts), 0) * 0.5 END AS silver_merge_seconds,
         greatest(unix_timestamp(f3.first_merge_ts) - unix_timestamp(f3.arrival_ts), 0) AS total_lifecycle_seconds,
         round(coalesce(f3.silver_batch_rows, 0) * f3.raw_rows / greatest(f3.batch_raw_rows, 1), 1) AS silver_merged_rows,
         round(coalesce(f3.silver_run_seconds_total, 0) * (coalesce(f3.silver_batch_rows, 0) * f3.raw_rows / greatest(f3.batch_raw_rows, 1)) / greatest(f3.silver_run_rows, 1), 3) AS silver_run_seconds
  FROM f3 WHERE rn = 1
),
f5 AS (
  SELECT f4.*,
         fpb.bytes_on_disk * f4.raw_rows / greatest(fpb.row_count, 1) AS bronze_bytes_pro_rata,
         fps.bytes_on_disk * f4.silver_merged_rows / greatest(fps.row_count, 1) AS silver_bytes_pro_rata,
         fpq.bytes_on_disk * f4.quarantined_rows / greatest(fpq.row_count, 1) AS quarantine_bytes_pro_rata,
         coalesce(f4.bronze_run_seconds, 0) + coalesce(f4.silver_run_seconds, 0) AS active_compute_seconds
  FROM f4
  LEFT JOIN storage_footprint fpb ON fpb.source_name = f4.source_name AND fpb.layer = 'bronze'
  LEFT JOIN storage_footprint fps ON fps.source_name = f4.source_name AND fps.layer = 'silver'
  LEFT JOIN storage_footprint fpq ON fpq.source_name = f4.source_name AND fpq.layer = 'quarantine'
),
job_usage AS (
  SELECT sum(usage_quantity) AS actual_dbus
  FROM system.billing.usage WHERE usage_metadata.job_id = '736782493336258'
),
price AS (
  SELECT min(pricing.default) AS price_per_dbu
  FROM system.billing.list_prices WHERE sku_name LIKE '%JOBS_SERVERLESS%' AND price_end_time IS NULL
),
grand AS (SELECT sum(raw_rows) AS total_raw_rows FROM f5)
SELECT
  f5.source_name, f5.file_name, f5.batch_id, f5.bronze_run_id AS run_id, f5.bronze_run_ts AS run_ts,
  f5.arrival_ts, f5.bronze_ingest_ts, f5.dq_ts, f5.first_merge_ts AS silver_merge_ts,
  cast(f5.arrival_to_bronze_seconds AS bigint) AS arrival_to_bronze_seconds,
  f5.bronze_run_seconds, round(f5.dq_seconds, 3) AS dq_seconds, round(f5.silver_merge_seconds, 3) AS silver_merge_seconds,
  f5.silver_run_seconds, cast(f5.total_lifecycle_seconds AS bigint) AS total_lifecycle_seconds,
  cast(f5.raw_rows AS bigint) AS raw_rows, cast(f5.bronze_rows AS bigint) AS bronze_rows,
  f5.quarantined_rows, cast(f5.rescued_rows AS bigint) AS rescued_rows, f5.silver_merged_rows,
  cast(f5.raw_file_bytes AS bigint) AS raw_file_bytes,
  cast(round(f5.bronze_bytes_pro_rata, 0) AS bigint) AS bronze_bytes_pro_rata,
  cast(round(f5.silver_bytes_pro_rata, 0) AS bigint) AS silver_bytes_pro_rata,
  cast(round(f5.quarantine_bytes_pro_rata, 0) AS bigint) AS quarantine_bytes_pro_rata,
  cast(round(f5.raw_file_bytes + coalesce(f5.bronze_bytes_pro_rata, 0) + coalesce(f5.silver_bytes_pro_rata, 0) + coalesce(f5.quarantine_bytes_pro_rata, 0), 0) AS bigint) AS total_storage_bytes,
  round(f5.active_compute_seconds, 3) AS active_compute_seconds,
  p.price_per_dbu,
  CASE WHEN ju.actual_dbus IS NOT NULL THEN round(ju.actual_dbus * f5.raw_rows / greatest(g.total_raw_rows, 1), 6)
       ELSE round(f5.active_compute_seconds / 3600.0, 8) END AS dbus_allocated,
  CASE WHEN ju.actual_dbus IS NOT NULL THEN round(ju.actual_dbus * p.price_per_dbu * f5.raw_rows / greatest(g.total_raw_rows, 1), 6)
       ELSE round(f5.active_compute_seconds / 3600.0 * p.price_per_dbu, 6) END AS cost_usd,
  CASE WHEN ju.actual_dbus IS NOT NULL THEN 'billing_usage' ELSE 'estimated' END AS cost_source,
  round((CASE WHEN ju.actual_dbus IS NOT NULL THEN ju.actual_dbus * p.price_per_dbu * f5.raw_rows / greatest(g.total_raw_rows, 1)
       ELSE f5.active_compute_seconds / 3600.0 * p.price_per_dbu END) / greatest(f5.raw_rows, 1), 8) AS cost_per_row,
  CASE WHEN ju.actual_dbus IS NOT NULL THEN round(ju.actual_dbus * p.price_per_dbu * f5.raw_rows / greatest(g.total_raw_rows, 1), 6)
       ELSE round(f5.active_compute_seconds / 3600.0 * p.price_per_dbu, 6) END AS cost_per_file,
  round(f5.total_lifecycle_seconds / greatest(f5.raw_rows, 1), 4) AS seconds_per_row
FROM f5
CROSS JOIN job_usage ju
CROSS JOIN price p
CROSS JOIN grand g
views.v_freshness_sla:
CREATE VIEW ops.v_freshness_sla (
  source_name,
  last_bronze_ingest,
  last_silver_merge,
  bronze_age_hours,
  silver_age_hours,
  freshness_status)
DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_BINARY
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS WITH base AS (SELECT 'src_001_customers' AS source_name, (SELECT max(_ingest_ts) FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_001_customers) AS last_bronze_ingest, (SELECT max(_merged_ts) FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_001_customers) AS last_silver_merge UNION ALL SELECT 'src_002_orders' AS source_name, (SELECT max(_ingest_ts) FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_002_orders) AS last_bronze_ingest, (SELECT max(_merged_ts) FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_002_orders) AS last_silver_merge UNION ALL SELECT 'src_003_payments' AS source_name, (SELECT max(_ingest_ts) FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_003_payments) AS last_bronze_ingest, (SELECT max(_merged_ts) FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_003_payments) AS last_silver_merge UNION ALL SELECT 'src_004_employees' AS source_name, (SELECT max(_ingest_ts) FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_004_employees) AS last_bronze_ingest, (SELECT max(_merged_ts) FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_004_employees) AS last_silver_merge UNION ALL SELECT 'src_005_products' AS source_name, (SELECT max(_ingest_ts) FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_005_products) AS last_bronze_ingest, (SELECT max(_merged_ts) FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_005_products) AS last_silver_merge UNION ALL SELECT 'src_006_order_lines' AS source_name, (SELECT max(_ingest_ts) FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_006_order_lines) AS last_bronze_ingest, (SELECT max(_merged_ts) FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_006_order_lines) AS last_silver_merge UNION ALL SELECT 'src_008_machine_vibration' AS source_name, (SELECT max(_ingest_ts) FROM mdd_platform.bronze.src_008_machine_vibration) AS last_bronze_ingest, (SELECT max(_merged_ts) FROM mdd_platform.silver.src_008_machine_vibration) AS last_silver_merge) SELECT source_name, last_bronze_ingest, last_silver_merge, round((unix_timestamp(current_timestamp())-unix_timestamp(last_bronze_ingest))/3600.0,2) AS bronze_age_hours, round((unix_timestamp(current_timestamp())-unix_timestamp(last_silver_merge))/3600.0,2) AS silver_age_hours, CASE WHEN (unix_timestamp(current_timestamp())-unix_timestamp(last_bronze_ingest))/3600.0 < 2 THEN 'fresh' WHEN (unix_timestamp(current_timestamp())-unix_timestamp(last_bronze_ingest))/3600.0 < 24 THEN 'stale' ELSE 'critical' END AS freshness_status FROM base

CREATE VIEW ops.v_job_cost (
  usage_date COMMENT 'Date of the usage record, this field can be used for faster aggregation by date',
  sku_name COMMENT 'Name of the SKU',
  usage_type COMMENT 'The type of usage attributed to the product or workload for billing purposes. Possible values are COMPUTE_TIME, STORAGE_SPACE, NETWORK_BYTES, NETWORK_BANDWIDTH, API_CALLS, TOKEN, or GPU_TIME.',
  dbus COMMENT 'Number of units consumed for this record.',
  job_id,
  job_run_id,
  job_name)
DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_BINARY
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS SELECT usage_date, sku_name, usage_type, usage_quantity AS dbus,
  usage_metadata.job_id, usage_metadata.job_run_id, usage_metadata.job_name
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE cast(usage_metadata as string) LIKE '%736782493336258%' OR usage_metadata.job_id = 736782493336258

CREATE VIEW ops.v_job_runs (
  run_id COMMENT 'The ID of the job run.',
  trigger_type COMMENT 'The type of trigger that can fire a run. For possible values, see [Trigger type values](https://docs.databricks.com/en/admin/system-tables/jobs.html#trigger)',
  result_state COMMENT 'The outcome of the job run. For possible values, see [Result state values](https://docs.databricks.com/en/admin/system-tables/jobs.html#result).',
  termination_type COMMENT 'The type of termination for the job run. **Not populated for rows emitted before late November 2025**',
  termination_code COMMENT 'The termination code of the job run. For possible values, see [Termination code values](https://docs.databricks.com/en/admin/system-tables/jobs.html#termination). **Not populated for rows emitted before late August 2024.**',
  period_start_time COMMENT 'The start time for the run or for the time period. Timezone information is recorded at the end of the value with +00:00 representing UTC.',
  period_end_time COMMENT 'The end time for the run or for the time period. Timezone information is recorded at the end of the value with +00:00 representing UTC.',
  setup_duration_seconds COMMENT 'The duration of the setup phase for the job run in seconds. **Not populated for rows emitted before late November 2025**',

views.v_lifecycle_cost_kpis:
CREATE VIEW ops.v_lifecycle_cost_kpis (
  source_name,
  total_estimated_cost_usd,
  cost_per_file_usd,
  cost_per_row_usd,
  cost_per_mb_usd,
  avg_lifecycle_seconds_per_file,
  total_storage_bytes,
  estimated_memory_gb_hours,
  files_processed,
  total_rows_processed)
COMMENT 'Cost and capacity KPIs per source plus grand total (source_name = ALL_SOURCES). total_estimated_cost_usd = sum of per-file allocated DBU cost (billing-based once system.billing.usage rows for orchestration job 433265226360788 land, about 1 day lag; estimated from active compute time x DBU list price before that - see v_file_lifecycle_cost). cost_per_mb_usd is over raw landing MB. total_storage_bytes = raw landing + bronze + silver + quarantine table bytes from v_storage_footprint (exact from system.storage.table_metrics_history once daily snapshots include the tables, estimated before). estimated_memory_gb_hours = assumed 8 GB worker memory x active compute hours (bronze+silver run durations) - serverless jobs workers are not directly observable, so this is a documented planning assumption, not a metered value.'
DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_BINARY
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM mdd_platform.ops.v_file_lifecycle_cost),
storage AS (
  SELECT source_name, sum(bytes_on_disk) AS total_storage_bytes
  FROM mdd_platform.ops.v_storage_footprint GROUP BY 1
),
per_source AS (
  SELECT f.source_name,
         sum(f.cost_usd) AS total_cost,
         count(*) AS files,
         sum(f.raw_rows) AS raw_rows,
         sum(f.raw_file_bytes) AS raw_bytes,
         avg(f.total_lifecycle_seconds) AS avg_life,
         sum(f.active_compute_seconds) AS active_seconds,
         max(s.total_storage_bytes) AS storage_bytes
  FROM f JOIN storage s USING (source_name)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT source_name,
       round(total_cost, 4) AS total_estimated_cost_usd,
       round(total_cost / greatest(files, 1), 4) AS cost_per_file_usd,
       round(total_cost / greatest(raw_rows, 1), 8) AS cost_per_row_usd,
       round(total_cost / greatest(raw_bytes / 1048576.0, 0.000001), 8) AS cost_per_mb_usd,
       round(avg_life, 1) AS avg_lifecycle_seconds_per_file,
       cast(storage_bytes AS bigint) AS total_storage_bytes,
       round(8.0 * active_seconds / 3600.0, 4) AS estimated_memory_gb_hours,
       cast(files AS bigint) AS files_processed,
       cast(raw_rows AS bigint) AS total_rows_processed
FROM per_source
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ALL_SOURCES',
       round(sum(total_cost), 4),
       round(sum(total_cost) / greatest(sum(files), 1), 4),
       round(sum(total_cost) / greatest(sum(raw_rows), 1), 8),
       round(sum(total_cost) / greatest(sum(raw_bytes) / 1048576.0, 0.000001), 8),
       round(sum(avg_life * files) / greatest(sum(files), 1), 1),
       cast(sum(storage_bytes) AS bigint),
       round(8.0 * sum(active_seconds) / 3600.0, 4),
       cast(sum(files) AS bigint),
       cast(sum(raw_rows) AS bigint)
FROM per_source

CREATE VIEW ops.v_pii_coverage (
  table_name,
  column_name,
  declared_pii_type,

  pii_type_tag,
  sensitivity_tag,
  mask_name,
  is_tagged,
  is_masked,
  governance_status)
DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_BINARY
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS WITH declared AS (
  SELECT source_name, explode(from_json(pii_columns, 'map<string,string>')) AS (column_name, pii_type)
  FROM mdd_platform.config.pipeline_configs WHERE active),
tags AS (
  SELECT table_name, column_name,
    max(CASE WHEN tag_name='pii' THEN tag_value END) AS governed_pii_tag,
    max(CASE WHEN tag_name='pii_type' THEN tag_value END) AS pii_type_tag,
    max(CASE WHEN tag_name='sensitivity' THEN tag_value END) AS sensitivity_tag
  FROM mdd_platform.information_schema.column_tags WHERE schema_name='silver' GROUP BY 1,2),
masks AS (SELECT table_name, column_name, mask_name FROM mdd_platform.information_schema.column_masks)
SELECT d.source_name AS table_name, d.column_name, d.pii_type AS declared_pii_type,
  t.governed_pii_tag, t.pii_type_tag, t.sensitivity_tag, m.mask_name,
  t.column_name IS NOT NULL AS is_tagged, m.column_name IS NOT NULL AS is_masked,
  CASE WHEN t.column_name IS NOT NULL AND m.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'fully_governed'
       WHEN t.column_name IS NOT NULL OR m.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'partial'
       ELSE 'not_governed' END AS governance_status
FROM declared d
LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.table_name=d.source_name AND t.column_name=d.column_name
LEFT JOIN masks m ON m.table_name=d.source_name AND m.column_name=d.column_name

CREATE VIEW ops.v_stage_cost_summary (
  source_name,
  layer,
  total_duration_seconds,
  total_cost_usd,
  rows_processed,
  cost_per_1k_rows,
  avg_stage_latency_seconds)
COMMENT 'Cost summary per source x pipeline stage (bronze ingest / data quality / silver merge). Built from ops.v_file_lifecycle_cost: stage durations are that view s per-file stage seconds (bronze = bronze-layer run_log compute duration pro-rated by row share; dq and silver = observed wall-clock spans between lifecycle events, upper bounds of stage compute since per-stage compute is not instrumented). total_cost_usd = per-file allocated DBU cost (see v_file_lifecycle_cost cost model) allocated to the stage pro-rata by stage seconds share of total (bronze+dq+silver) stage time. cost_per_1k_rows = stage cost per 1,000 rows processed. avg_stage_latency_seconds = average per-file stage duration.'
DEFAULT COLLATION UTF8_BINARY
WITH SCHEMA COMPENSATION
AS WITH stages AS (
  SELECT source_name, 'bronze' AS layer, bronze_run_seconds AS stage_seconds, raw_rows AS rows_processed
  FROM mdd_platform.ops.v_file_lifecycle_cost
  UNION ALL
  SELECT source_name, 'dq' AS layer, dq_seconds AS stage_seconds, raw_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.ops.v_file_lifecycle_cost
  UNION ALL
  SELECT source_name, 'silver' AS layer, silver_merge_seconds AS stage_seconds, silver_merged_rows
  FROM mdd_platform.ops.v_file_lifecycle_cost
),
file_cost AS (
  SELECT source_name,
         sum(cost_usd) AS total_cost,
         sum(coalesce(bronze_run_seconds, 0) + coalesce(dq_seconds, 0) + coalesce(silver_merge_seconds, 0)) AS total_stage_seconds
  FROM mdd_platform.ops.v_file_lifecycle_cost GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.source_name, s.layer,
       round(sum(s.stage_seconds), 1) AS total_duration_seconds,
       round(sum(coalesce(s.stage_seconds, 0)) / greatest(fc.total_stage_seconds, 0.001) * fc.total_cost, 6) AS total_cost_usd,
       cast(sum(s.rows_processed) AS bigint) AS rows_processed,
       round(1000 * sum(coalesce(s.stage_seconds, 0)) / greatest(fc.total_stage_seconds, 0.001) * fc.total_cost
             / greatest(sum(s.rows_processed), 1), 6) AS cost_per_1k_rows,
       round(avg(s.stage_seconds), 1) AS avg_stage_latency_seconds
FROM stages s JOIN file_cost fc USING (source_name)
GROUP BY s.source_name, s.layer, fc.total_cost, fc.total_stage_seconds
